name: ZapOrder – Pedidos pelo WhatsApp, Botão Flutuante e Catálogo for WooCommerce
author: wooglobalapps

sections.description:
Em português

ZapOrder transforma a sua loja WooCommerce em uma máquina de pedidos pelo WhatsApp em dois minutos: botão “Pedir pelo WhatsApp” na página do produto (com variação, quantidade, preço e link na mensagem), envio do carrinho inteiro pelo WhatsApp, botão flutuante de chat em todas as páginas, modo catálogo (sem carrinho e sem checkout) e opção de esconder preços para “pedir orçamento”. Textos, cores e modelos de mensagem personalizáveis. Usa o link oficial wa.me: sem API, sem mensalidade, funciona com WhatsApp e WhatsApp Business. Gratuito.

Most small stores in Brazil, Latin America, India, Spain and Portugal close their sales on WhatsApp. ZapOrder turns your WooCommerce store into a WhatsApp ordering machine in two minutes.

Free features

  • Order on WhatsApp button on product pages. The message already includes the product, the selected variation (size, color…), quantity, price and link.
  • Send cart via WhatsApp: the customer sends the full cart (items, quantities and total) to you in one tap. Works with the classic cart and the new Cart block.
  • Floating WhatsApp chat button on every page.
  • Catalog mode: remove “Add to cart” and checkout. Customers order only through WhatsApp.
  • Hide prices for “ask for a quote” stores.
  • Buttons on shop and category pages.
  • Custom button texts, color and message templates with placeholders: {product} {qty} {price} {sku} {url}.
  • Uses the official wa.me link: no API, no monthly WhatsApp fee, works with WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business.
  • Generate with AI: describe what you want (a setting, a design change, texts, a custom feature) in the plugin screen and the AI assistant answers in the same chat.
  • Compatible with HPOS and the Cart/Checkout blocks.
  • Translation ready.

External services

This plugin connects to the WooGlobal Apps assistant service (https://conexao-support.vercel.app) only when an administrator uses the “Generate with AI” tab:

  • When you click Send, the plugin sends your message, your site address, the email you typed (optional), your site name and language and the plugin version, so the answer can be delivered back to your site.
  • While the “Generate with AI” tab is open, and only after you have sent a message, the plugin loads the conversation from the service.
  • When you delete the plugin, it asks the service to delete your conversation.

Nothing is sent from your store front, from your customers or before you click Send. Terms: https://wooglobal-apps.vercel.app/terms.html — Privacy policy: https://wooglobal-apps.vercel.app/privacy.html

Support & free setup

ZapOrder works fully on its own: every feature is free and nothing is locked or required.

If you want a hand, the plugin screen (WooCommerce → ZapOrder WhatsApp) has a Generate with AI tab (see “External services”), a Help tab with quick tips and a Hire us tab. The “Talk to us on WhatsApp” and “Hire on WhatsApp” buttons are plain links: they open WhatsApp with a short message that contains only the plugin name and version (or the service you clicked). Nothing is sent automatically and no store data is shared.

  • Free setup: we install and configure ZapOrder on your store for free.
  • Custom work (optional): automatic order-status messages, abandoned cart recovery via WhatsApp, multiple agents / department routing, custom button and message design. See our services.
  • Questions and bug reports: support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the zaporder folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  3. Activate ZapOrder.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → ZapOrder WhatsApp, enter your number with country code (e.g. 5511999998888) and save.
sections.faq:
Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?

No. ZapOrder uses the free wa.me click-to-chat link. Any WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business number works.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. The message includes the selected attributes, quantity and the variation price. If no option is selected, the customer is asked to choose one first.

Can I disable the normal checkout?

Yes. Turn on Catalog mode: the Add to cart buttons and the checkout page are removed, and customers order through WhatsApp.

Does it collect any data?

No store or customer data is collected. Clicking the button opens WhatsApp with the message pre-filled. The only connection to an external server is the optional “Generate with AI” tab, and only when an administrator clicks Send (see “External services”).

What can I ask in “Generate with AI”?

Anything related to your store and this plugin: settings, design changes, texts and translations, or a custom feature. The answer appears in the same chat, usually within a few hours.
